description_en: Queries the details of a content moderation job
description_zh: 调用QueryMediaCensorJobDetail查询媒体审核作业的详细信息
name: QueryMediaCensorJobDetail

parameters.help_en: The ID of the content moderation job. You can obtain the ID from the response parameters of https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/444848.html
parameters.help_zh: 媒体审核作业ID。可以从https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/444848.html的返回参数中获取
parameters.name: job_id

parameters.help_en: The token for the next page. Leave this parameter empty for the first request. The token is returned after the first query
parameters.help_zh: 下一页标识，第一次提交时为空即可。下一页标识将在第一次查询后返回
parameters.name: next_page_token

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries to return per page.

Default value: 30.

Valid values: 1 to 300
parameters.help_zh:
每页最大返回数。

默认值：30

取值范围：1~300
parameters.name: maximum_page_size

Label.description_en:
The label of the moderation result. Valid values:

normal: normal

spam: spam

ad: advertisement

abuse: abuse

flood: flooding

contraband: contraband

meaningless: meaningless

spam：含垃圾信息
ad：广告
abuse：辱骂
flood：灌水
contraband：违禁

Label.description_en:
The label of the moderation result.
Categories for intelligent pornography detection (porn) in images:
    - normal: normal
    - sexy: sexy
    - porn: pornographic
Categories for terrorism and political content (terrorism) in images:
    - normal: normal
    - bloody: bloody
    - explosion: explosion and smoke
    - outfit: special outfit
    - logo: special logo
    - weapon: weapon
    - politics: political content
    - violence: violence
    - crowd: crowd
    - parade: parade
    - carcrash: car crash
    - flag: flag
    - location: landmark
    - others: others
Categories for text and image violations (ad):
    - normal: normal
    - ad: other advertisements
    - politics: political content in text
    - porn: pornographic content in text
    - abuse: abusive content in text
    - terrorism: terrorism content in text
    - contraband: contraband content in text
    - spam: other spam content in text
    - npx: nuisance ad
    - qrcode: QR code
    - programCode: mini program code
Categories for inappropriate scenes (live) in images:
    - normal: normal
    - meaningless: no content in the image, such as a black or white screen
    - PIP: picture-in-picture
    - smoking: smoking
    - drivelive: live streaming in a car
Categories for image logos (logo):
    - normal: normal
    - TV: controlled logo
    - trademark: trademark
